Transform the character into a gentle little ghost representing the deceased pet, clearly distinguishable from sleeping: keep the exact recognizable face, ears/crest, species markings and characteristic tail motif; eyes peacefully closed; a small simple outlined halo floats above its head. The ghost body is a single rounded, tapering wisp with a softly curled lower end INSTEAD OF LEGS. No paws, arms or legs; ghost anatomy is deliberately a single clean wisp, never duplicated limbs. Square canvas. Entire character and halo visible, centered, generous white margin on all sides. Plain opaque white background. One character only. No text, letters, UI, frame, furniture, landscape, tombstone, religious symbols, stars floating around or extra objects. Do not return a sprite sheet or contact sheet.
